text: No human is limited.
author: Eliud Kipchoge
title: Marathon World Record Holder (2:01:39)

text: The pain of running relieves the pain of living.
author: Jacqueline Simon Gunn
title: Clinical Psychologist & Author

text: Run when you can, walk if you have to, crawl if you must; just never give up.
author: Dean Karnazes
title: Ultramarathon Runner

text: Every day is a good day when you run.
author: Kevin Nelson
title: Running Author

text: Your body will argue that there is no justifiable reason to continue. Your only recourse is to call on your spirit.
author: Tim Noakes
title: Exercise Scientist

text: I run because long after my footprints fade away, maybe I will have inspired a few to reject the easy path.
author: Dean Karnazes
title: Ultramarathon Runner

text: Don't dream of winning. Train for it.
author: Mo Farah
title: 4× Olympic Gold Medalist

text: The miracle isn't that I finished. The miracle is that I had the courage to start.
author: John Bingham
title: Runner & Author

text: Running is about finding your inner peace, and so is a life well lived.
author: Dean Karnazes
title: Ultramarathon Runner

text: One run can change your day. Many runs can change your life.
author: Unknown
title: Running Proverb

text: The will to win means nothing without the will to prepare.
author: Juma Ikangaa
title: NYC Marathon Winner

text: Pain is temporary. It may last a minute, or an hour, or a day, or a year, but eventually it will subside. If I quit, it lasts forever.
author: Lance Armstrong
title: Tour de France Champion

text: I always loved running… it was something you could do by yourself, and under your own power.
author: Jesse Owens
title: 4× Olympic Gold Medalist (1936)

text: If you want to become the best runner you can be, start now. Don't spend the rest of your life wondering if you can do it.
author: Priscilla Welch
title: Marathon Champion

text: The man who can drive himself further once the effort gets painful is the man who will win.
author: Roger Bannister
title: First Sub-4 Minute Mile

text: We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act, but a habit.
author: Aristotle
title: Philosopher

text: No matter how slow you go, you are still lapping everybody on the couch.
author: Unknown
title: Running Proverb

text: Someone who is busier than you is running right now.
author: Nike
title: Slogan

text: Running is the greatest metaphor for life, because you get out of it what you put into it.
author: Oprah Winfrey
title: Media Mogul & Marathon Finisher

text: The only way to define your limits is by going beyond them.
author: Arthur C. Clarke
title: Science Fiction Writer

text: To give anything less than your best is to sacrifice the gift.
author: Steve Prefontaine
title: Legendary Distance Runner

text: I cannot have survival as my only goal. That would be too boring. My goal is to come in first place.
author: Wilma Rudolph
title: 3× Olympic Gold Medalist

text: There is no such thing as bad weather, only weak people.
author: Bill Bowerman
title: Nike Co-Founder & Track Coach

text: Success isn't how far you got, but the distance you traveled from where you started.
author: Steve Prefontaine
title: Legendary Distance Runner

text: You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
author: Zig Ziglar
title: Motivational Speaker

text: The first kilometer is a liar.
author: Running Proverb

text: A 12-minute mile is just as far as a 6-minute mile.
author: Unknown
title: Running Proverb

text: It's very hard in the beginning to understand that the whole idea is not to beat the other runners. Eventually you learn that the competition is against the little voice inside you.
author: George Sheehan
title: Running Philosopher

text: I breathe in strength and breathe out weakness.
author: Amy Hastings
title: Olympic Marathon Runner

text: If it doesn't challenge you, it won't change you.
author: Fred DeVito
title: Fitness Expert

text: 吃不了训练的苦，就要吃比赛的苦。
author: 中国跑者
title: Ultra Runner

text: 人生就是一场马拉松。
author: 中国谚语

text: 每一步都算数。
author: 跑者格言

text: 不只跑得快，更要跑得远。
author: 马拉松精神

text: 坚持就是胜利。
author: 跑步哲学

text: 我没有想太多，只是专注每一步。
author: 刘翔 (Liu Xiang)
title: Olympic Gold Medalist, 110m Hurdles

text: 跑步是跟自己对话的最好方式。
author: 中国马拉松跑者

text: 快慢没关系，重要的是你还在跑。
author: 跑者社区

text: 跑不动的时候，正是变强的开始。
author: 健身教练

text: 今天流的汗，是明天别人追不上的距离。
author: 跑者格言

text: 跑步不需要理由，不跑步才需要借口。
author: 跑步圈名言

text: The obsession with running is really an obsession with the potential for more and more life.
author: George Sheehan
title: Running Philosopher

text: The reason we race isn't so much to beat each other… but to be with each other.
author: Christopher McDougall
title: Author, Born to Run

text: A runner's creed: I will win; if I cannot win, I shall be second; if I cannot be second, I shall be third; if I cannot be third, I shall not shame my effort.
author: Dr. George Sheehan
title: Running Philosopher

text: The body achieves what the mind believes.
author: Napoleon Hill
title: Author, Think and Grow Rich

text: Most people never run far enough on their first wind to find out they've got a second.
author: William James
title: Philosopher

text: You can't run away from your problems. But there's no law that says you can't make them wheeze a little bit.
author: Unknown
title: Running Humor

text: 出出汗，心情就会好起来。
author: 跑步爱好者

text: 别说你做不到，你还没试过。
author: 跑者格言

text: 跑步是最好的药。
author: 中国医生跑者

text: 世界那么大，跑着去看看。
author: 跑者社区
